<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 450" width="100%" height="100%">
  <!-- White background rect -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Style definitions -->
  <style>
    .math { font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-style: italic; }
    .text { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #000000; }
    .bold { font-weight: bold; }
    .line { stroke: #000000; stroke-width: 2; fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .thin-line { stroke: #000000; stroke-width: 1.5; fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .dimension { stroke: #000000; stroke-width: 1; fill: none; }
    .liquid { fill: #d3d3d3; stroke: #000000; stroke-width: 2; }
  </style>

  <!-- Bell jar -->
  <!-- Base plate -->
  <rect x="100" y="340" width="300" height="20" class="line" fill="#e6e6e6" />
  <line x1="120" y1="360" x2="160" y2="390" class="line" />
  <line x1="380" y1="360" x2="340" y2="390" class="line" />

  <!-- Bell jar dome -->
  <path d="M 160 340 C 160 200, 200 120, 250 120 C 300 120, 340 200, 340 340" class="line" fill="rgba(240,248,255,0.5)" />

  <!-- Tube B at top of bell jar -->
  <rect x="235" y="100" width="30" height="25" class="line" fill="#ffffff" />
  <line x1="265" y1="110" x2="300" y2="110" class="thin-line" />
  <path d="M 300 100 Q 315 100, 315 115 Q 315 130, 300 130" class="thin-line" />
  <text x="325" y="115" class="text bold">B</text>

  <!-- Dish of mercury -->
  <path d="M 170 350 L 170 400 L 330 400 L 330 350" class="line" fill="#ffffff" />
  <!-- Mercury inside dish -->
  <path d="M 173 370 L 173 397 L 327 397 L 327 370 Z" class="liquid" />

  <!-- Glass tube inverted -->
  <rect x="235" y="180" width="30" height="200" class="line" fill="#ffffff" />
  <!-- Mercury column inside tube -->
  <rect x="237" y="240" width="26" height="157" class="liquid" />

  <!-- Vacuum/space at top of tube -->
  <!-- (empty space inside rect from y=180 to y=240) -->

  <!-- Dimension / height indicator for mercury column -->
  <!-- Double-headed arrow on the left of the tube -->
  <line x1="210" y1="240" x2="210" y2="397" class="dimension" />
  <polygon points="210,240 206,250 214,250" fill="#000000" />
  <polygon points="210,397 206,387 214,387" fill="#000000" />
  <!-- Horizontal tick marks for height -->
  <line x1="205" y1="240" x2="235" y2="240" class="thin-line" stroke-dasharray="2,2" />
  <line x1="205" y1="397" x2="235" y2="397" class="thin-line" stroke-dasharray="2,2" />
  
  <text x="185" y="325" class="math">h</text>

  <!-- Labels -->
  <!-- Glass tube label and pointer -->
  <text x="70" y="210" class="text">glass tube</text>
  <path d="M 135 210 L 235 245" class="thin-line" />

  <!-- Bell jar label and pointer -->
  <text x="60" y="160" class="text">bell jar</text>
  <path d="M 115 160 L 190 190" class="thin-line" />

  <!-- Mercury label and pointer -->
  <text x="340" y="380" class="text">mercury</text>
  <path d="M 338 380 L 270 380" class="thin-line" />

  <!-- Fig 6.1 caption -->
  <text x="210" y="430" class="text bold">Fig. 6.1</text>
</svg>
